description: Independently authored English retrieval queries for the uploaded historical edition. Expected section identities follow the source; the duplicate printed Section 189 and absent Section 168 are intentionally not treated as corrected law.

queries.query: Under Section 1, what happens when another law is inconsistent with the Constitution?
Which provision describes Nigeria as one indivisible and indissoluble sovereign state?
Where does the Constitution list the states of the Federation and define the Federal Capital Territory?
Under Section 4, how are legislative powers divided between the National Assembly and State Houses of Assembly?
Which provision vests federal executive powers in the President?
Under Section 6, which courts exercise judicial powers in Nigeria?
Which section guarantees democratically elected local government councils?
Under Section 9, what procedure is required to alter the Constitution?
Which provision prohibits the Federation or a State from adopting a state religion?
Under Section 12, when does an international treaty have the force of law in Nigeria?
Under Section 14, what does federal character require for government composition?
Which section states that the social order is founded on freedom, equality and justice?
Which provision discusses free education and the eradication of illiteracy?
Where does the Constitution list discipline, integrity, dignity of labour and social justice as national ethics?
Under Section 25, who qualifies as a citizen of Nigeria by birth?
Under Section 27, what qualifications must a person meet for Nigerian citizenship by naturalisation?
Which provision allows a citizen of full age to renounce Nigerian citizenship?
Where is the constitutional right to life protected?
Which provision prohibits torture, inhuman treatment, slavery and forced labour?
Under Section 35, what safeguards protect a person arrested or detained?
Under Section 36, what protections apply to a person charged with a criminal offence?
Which provision protects citizens' homes, correspondence, telephone conversations and telegraphic communications?
Which provision guarantees freedom of thought, conscience and religion?
Which provision guarantees freedom to hold opinions and receive and impart information?
Where is the right to assemble freely and associate with other persons protected?
Which provision guarantees citizens freedom of movement throughout Nigeria?
Under Section 42, what forms of discrimination against Nigerian citizens are prohibited?
Which section gives citizens the right to acquire and own immovable property anywhere in Nigeria?
Under Section 44, what compensation safeguards apply to compulsory acquisition of property?
Which section permits an application to the High Court for enforcement of fundamental rights?
Under Section 54, what is the quorum of the Senate and House of Representatives?
Under Section 58, how does the National Assembly exercise federal legislative power through bills?
Which section sets out how an elected member of the National Assembly may be recalled?
Under Section 85, who audits the public accounts of the Federation?
Under Section 131 in this source edition, what qualifications apply to election as President?
Under Section 143, how may the President or Vice-President be removed for gross misconduct?
Under Section 153, which federal commissions and councils are established?
Under Section 162, what revenues are paid into the Federation Account?
Under Section 188, what process applies to removal of a State Governor or Deputy Governor?
Which provision establishes the Nigeria Police Force and prohibits other police forces?
Which provision establishes the armed forces and states their constitutional duties?
Under Section 230, how is the Supreme Court of Nigeria constituted?
Under Section 287, who must enforce decisions of the Supreme Court and other superior courts?
Under Section 305, in which situations can the President proclaim a state of emergency?
Under Section 308, which public officers have immunity from civil or criminal proceedings while in office?
What is the wording of the Oath of Allegiance in the Seventh Schedule?
What does the presidential oath of office in the Seventh Schedule require the President to swear?
What does the Governor of a State swear in the oath of office in the Seventh Schedule?
What oath must a member of the National Assembly or a House of Assembly take?
What promises appear in the Judicial Oath in the Seventh Schedule?
